## independent.shellcommand

**Frozen contract:** [capability mapping](../../schema/capability-mappings/supported/independent.shellcommand.json). **Legacy source:** OVAL 5.12.3; shellcommand_test.

| Object field | Content-author help | Known scanner contract | Pending research |

| `command` | Command text executed by the selected interpreter. | Command execution is trust-sensitive; validation of trusted content belongs outside the command string. | How should execution timeouts, cancellation, and output limits be reported? |
| `pattern` | Optional regular expression used to retain matching stdout lines. | Matches stdout lines; matching lines and captured subexpressions remain separately observable. | What exact line splitting and regex conformance vectors are required? |
| `shell` | Interpreter used to run the authored command; use one of the allowed shell names. | Select the interpreter specified by the Assessment. | How should a missing interpreter or launch failure be represented? |

**Additional declared collection parameters:** `error_if_exit_status_not_0`, `error_if_stderr_exists`.

**Collected fields:** `shell`, `command`, `pattern`, `exit_status`, `stdout_line`, `subexpression`, `stderr_line`.

**Semantic validator rules:**

- `independent.shellcommand.filter_state_capability`: Every Set filter State reference must resolve to capability independent.shellcommand.
- `independent.shellcommand.pattern_semantics`: When object.pattern is present it is a regular expression applied to stdout lines; matching output lines and capture subexpressions remain separately observable.
- `independent.shellcommand.trusted_content`: Execution of publisher-supplied commands is trust-sensitive. Package/signature verification policy SHALL be enforced outside the command string itself and scanners SHOULD avoid executing unsigned or untrusted content according to deployment policy.
- `independent.shellcommand.not_generic_escape_hatch`: This capability represents command-oriented assessment. It SHALL NOT replace native scanner capabilities when doing so would discard meaningful native collection semantics such as controlled filesystem traversal, structured evidence, or bounded collection.
